answer: Jade anchor seals stop cheap sybils. An alias earns its jade seal only after 3 completed jobs, each checked by a different requester, and the seal anchors the alias to that work history. New aliases without a seal pay a 5 POA entry bond and take only jobs under 2 POA. A gale of fresh aliases still arrives, but each one must pay and work before it can bid on real jobs. If 2 of the last 10 jobs draw a confirmed dispute, the seal is revoked, the alias freezes for 14 epochs, and the bond burns.
